title: Smart way to have fun and know the city with a fresh view
text: Yesterday my husband and I decided to try this activity in the city we have lived for some years. We thought, it maybe stimulating to see the city with other eyes…. What was our surprise to find that indeed was a great, fun and different experience to walk around Barcelona and to learn fun facts while we enjoyed the puzzles, trivia and un reveled the coding hidden on this great game. The directions were really well done and assertive how were explained and showed . Now, we want to complete the whole series with other friends, our kids or by ourselves. Well done!!!
